# Fallout 76 - Patch notes – July 26, 2022 / Patch 37

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_107_nukaknights-post-patchnotes37.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

Our latest Fallout 76 update delivers a slew of fresh bug fixes and improvements. Read on to find out where things are happening.

### UPDATE VERSION 1.6.4.78

Here you can find out the download size of today's patch on the respective platform:

**PC (Steam):** 3.0GB
**PC (Microsoft Store):** 8.1GB
**PlayStation:** 7.6GB
**Xbox:** 10.7GB

### BUG FIXES & IMPROVEMENTS

##### GRAPHICS

**Clothing:** The Black Halloween Pumpkin Helmet now correctly emits smoke and flame visual effects.
**Clothing:** Underarmor no longer peeks out from the Vault Survivor Outfit.
**Beds:** Characters no longer protrude through the Wavy Willard waterbed when climbing into the top bed.
**Chairs:** The character's hand now properly rests on the skull when sitting in the Bone Throne.
**Workbenches:** Meat no longer appears as if it is floating during the animation that plays when using the Chuckwagon Cooking Station.
##### C.A.M.P.S AND WORKSHOP

**Allies:** The Settler-Forager Ally can now once again give the player daily quests.
**Appliances:** The Wavy Willard Bubble Blower is now in the same row of items in the Build Menu as the Wavy Willard Bubble Machine. Previously it was displayed alone in an additional row.
**Collectron Stations:** The F.E.T.C.H. Collectron now properly counts as a robot.
**Exploit:** Fixed an exploit related to item duplication.
**Exploit:** Fixed an exploit that would allow players to transfer items from a public workshop to their C.A.M.P. could move.
**Floors:** The C.A.M.P. budget consumed by Wooden Hut Terraces now matches the cost of other terrace types.
**Floor decoration:** Classic pillars can now be placed on top of each other.
**Display Dolls:** The build limit for the Dr. Bones Skeleton Display Doll now matches the build limits of other display doll types.
**Survival Tents:** The salvage crate is now displayed correctly oriented in the Rusty Transport Survival Tent.
##### CHALLENGES

**Combat:** Destroying robots with Set's voice will now properly cause the "Destroy Robots with a Revolver" challenge to continue.
**Weekly Challenges:** Fixed an issue that prevented the weekly challenge “Kill a Giant Creature” from progressing correctly.
##### FIGHT

**V.A.T.S.:** Explosive V.A.T.S. weapon attacks no longer charge the critical strike bar twice.
##### QUESTS AND EVENTS

**Eviction Notice:** Fixes have been made to a small area near the Radiation Filter where players were taking significantly less Radiation Damage than intended while the Radiation Filter was broken.
**Eviction Notice:** The Radiant Filter windmill will now properly stop spinning if the Radiant Filter requires repair or the event fails.
**Grahm's Meat Happa:** Players can now receive rewards that correspond to the result of the Meat Happa, instead of always receiving items from the lowest reward tier of the event.
**Grahm's Meat Happa:** Grahm will no longer move away from the Meat Happa to explore other areas in the Forest region.
**The Heart of the Swamp:** The Strangler Heart now visually no longer appears to regenerate health despite taking damage.
**Attacker from Space:** When speaking to Homer at Black Mountain Ordnance Works, selecting the answer option "That's all for now" now properly closes the dialogue menu.
**Attacker from Space:** A bug has been fixed, you
